evidence.rule: Both lie on the back with bent knees and lift the hips off the floor. The equipment and the form are the same.
Both press two dumbbells from the chest while the lifter lies on a flat bench. The equipment and the form are the same.
Both records have the same steps: a barbell row with the torso bent forward until it is almost parallel to the floor.
A multipress is a Smith machine. Both are a back squat under the bar of a Smith machine.
Both lie on a flat bench and bend the elbows to lower two dumbbells toward the head, then extend the arms. The equipment and the form are the same.
